cases.explain: «Божьему человеку» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again.” The man of God interceded with Yahweh, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.

cases.explain: «Божьему человеку» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me, and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

cases.sentence: И он пошел ___, чтобы не возвращаться тем путем, по которому пришел в Вефиль.
cases.explain: «другой дорогой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

cases.sentence: В Вефиле же жил один ___, сыновья которого пришли и рассказали ему обо всем, что совершил там в тот день Божий человек.
cases.explain: «старый пророк» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

cases.sentence: Пока они еще сидели за столом, к ___, который возвратил его, было слово Господа.
cases.explain: «старому пророку» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

cases.sentence: Он закричал ___, который пришел из земель Иудеи:
cases.explain: «Божьему человеку» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s mouth, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

cases.sentence: Они пошли и рассказали об этом в том городе, где жил ___.
cases.explain: «старый пророк» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, men passed by, and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

cases.sentence: Пророк поднял тело ___, положил его на осла и привез обратно в город, чтобы оплакать и похоронить его.
cases.explain: «Божьего человека» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

cases.sentence: Но даже после этого Иеровоам не переменил своего ___ и снова назначил священников из народа в святилищах на возвышенностях.
cases.explain: «злого пути» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After this thing Jeroboam didn’t return from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
